case.believed: BufferAttribute.getX always returns the stored integer, geometry attributes are assigned directly, Object3D.traverse visits only descendants, and Texture.clone duplicates its Source.
contract: BufferAttribute.getX converts normalized Uint8 values into the 0..1 range while non-normalized attributes return raw stored values.
BufferGeometry.setAttribute replaces a named attribute and deleteAttribute removes it from the attributes map.
Object3D.traverse visits the root and then descendants in depth-first insertion order.
Texture.image aliases Texture.source.data, and Texture.clone shares the same Source object with the original texture.
case.goal: Prove three 0.185.1 core data APIs: normalized BufferAttribute getX reads, BufferGeometry attribute replacement and deletion, depth-first Object3D traversal, and Texture source sharing versus cloning.
